title: Prior High Low Sweep Reversal Behavior
sweep_definition: High sweep: High > Level + buffer AND Close < Level. Low sweep: Low < Level - buffer AND Close > Level. Buffer = max(price_precision_step, 0.05 * ATR14Prior). First touch per NYDate per LevelType classified as exactly Sweep or Breach.
on_level_restriction: ONH/ONL applied only for bars at NYMinuteOfDay >= 570 (09:30 NY) to avoid look-ahead before the overnight window closes.
ambiguous_rule: Events where stop and 1R target both trigger in the same bar are excluded from 1R-before-stop probability comparisons.
support_verdict_rule: InstrumentPass requires test-segment CI to exclude zero with adequate event counts. Train-only evidence does not satisfy the support criterion.
